# Loyalty Program Guy

> Kevin Graham (SMB AI Partners, Poway, CA) sets up and manages automated text message loyalty programs that help restaurants, salons, spas, and retail shops in San Diego County get more repeat customers. Local SenText Solutions agent. Programs are backed by the SMB AI Partners 3x ROI Guarantee.

Contact: text or call 858-218-6905, kevin@smbaipartners.com, or book a free walkthrough at https://calendly.com/smbaipartners.

## Services by industry
- [Text Message Loyalty Programs for Restaurants](https://loyaltyprogramguy.com/restaurants/): How San Diego restaurants and cafés use text loyalty programs to fill slow nights, bring diners back, and earn more reviews.
- [Text Message Loyalty Programs for Salons and Spas](https://loyaltyprogramguy.com/salons/): How salons, barbershops, and spas use text loyalty programs to rebook clients, fill last-minute openings, and grow reviews.
- [Text Message Loyalty Programs for Retail Shops](https://loyaltyprogramguy.com/retail/): How local retail shops use text loyalty programs to drive foot traffic, move inventory, and compete with online stores.

## Guides
- [How to Get More Repeat Customers (9 Ways That Work for Local Businesses)](https://loyaltyprogramguy.com/guides/how-to-get-repeat-customers/): Practical ways restaurants, salons, and shops get customers to come back: capture contact info, reward the second visit, and win back lapsed customers.
- [Paper Punch Card vs. Text Message Loyalty Program](https://loyaltyprogramguy.com/guides/punch-card-vs-text-loyalty-program/): A side-by-side comparison of paper punch cards and text message loyalty programs for local businesses: cost, customer data, follow-up, fraud, and results.
- [How Much Does an SMS Loyalty Program Cost?](https://loyaltyprogramguy.com/guides/sms-loyalty-program-cost/): What a text loyalty program costs a small business: monthly plans, setup fees, overages, compliance fees, and whether it pays for itself.
- [Win-Back Text Message Examples That Bring Customers Back](https://loyaltyprogramguy.com/guides/win-back-text-examples/): Copy-and-paste win-back text message examples for restaurants, salons, and retail shops, plus when to send them and the rules to follow.
